text.tspan: Time women and men spend on
Average hours per day that women and men aged 15
and older spend on unpaid care and domestic work.

tspan.tspan: United Nations Statistics Division and UN
Unpaid care and domestic work includes: food

text.tspan: preparation, dishwashing, upkeep of a dwelling, laundry,
ironing, gardening, caring for pets, shopping, servicing and
repair of personal and household goods, childcare, and care
of the sick, elderly or disabled household members, among
others. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from
the closest year between 2014 and 2025 is shown instead.
